messages.content:
Risk: Obscene/Abusive Content
Description: The AI system may generate or disseminate content that is obscene, degrading, or sexually abusive, including child sexual abuse material (CSAM) or non-consensual intimate images (NCII).
Concern: None
Policy: Sexually Explicit

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Law/LegalCore/Law: law — rule recognized by some community as regulating the behavior of its members and that it may enforce through the imposition of penalties [found by 7/13 queries]
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0000719: Inappropriate behavior — An explicit or perceived action, demonstration, conduct, or language (verbal and written) that is contrary to generally accepted norms, rules, procedures, or unacceptable within the context in which it is carried out. Inappropriate behaviors could take place in a sexual or social context and could be aggressive, violent, impulsive, intimidating, or threatening in nature. [found by 5/13 queries]
  Siblings: Socially inappropriate questioning, Overfriendliness, Inappropriate laughter
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PornographicContentDescription: Pornographic Content Description — Descriptions or generation of explicit sexual material intended for sexual arousal, mimicking pornographic media formats. [found by 10/13 queries]
  Siblings: Clinical Sexual Description, Explicit Sexual Description, Reproductive Health Boundary
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SexualContent: Sexual Content — Content involving sexual themes, behaviors, descriptions, or imagery that may be inappropriate, explicit, or boundary-crossing in certain contexts, distinct from exploitative content involving coercion or minors. [found by 9/13 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#NonConsensualIntimateImagery: Non-Consensual Intimate Imagery — Creation, distribution, or threat of distributing sexually explicit images or videos without the depicted individual's consent. [found by 8/13 queries]
  Siblings: Child Sexual Exploitation, Sexual Exploitation Harassment, Sexual Coercion

axes.rationale: This class directly addresses the risk of generating content with sexual themes, which aligns with the description of obscene/abusive content.
This class specifically captures the risk of generating or disseminating non-consensual intimate images, a key concern within the broader risk of obscene/abusive content.
This class covers a broader range of inappropriate actions, including those that could be sexually abusive or degrading, making it relevant to the overall risk.
